text:
rachel (recruiter): Quick coordination for Lena Ortiz (L3 ML Eng). Shes traveling the evening before the loop and needs onsite support for childcare logistics: a hotel hold night, a short childcare stipend for that day, and a family-friendly parking spot. Candidate asked for a later-morning start (10:30am) due to childcare drop-off. Can ops help?

sam (hiring mgr): 10:30 start is fine. We can do a remote screen 10:30-11:00 and onsite sessions 12:00-15:00. Please try to finish by 15:30 so she can pick up. Also ask interviewers to keep segments to 40m max.

lena (people-ops): We can do hotel hold for the night before + a one-time childcare stipend. Policy: childcare stipend up to $75 for same-day care; receipts required. We can also provide a dinner voucher for the evening if travel lands late. Travel-team, can you place a hotel hold and evening voucher?

travel-team: We can hold 1 night at the Marriott Downtown (free cancellation 24h) and issue a $40 dinner voucher + a rideshare code for airport pickup. Need candidate arrival ETA to confirm. ETA to send vouchers: 2 business hours.

rachel (recruiter): Lena's ETA: arriving 2026-05-19 20:45 local. Shed like to be within walking distance to the office in case of late arrival. I'll share exact flight.

facilities-bot: For the interview day we'll reserve Conf J (family-friendly) 11:45-15:45 and a visitor parking spot in the short-term lot (Family Spot F1) reserved 11:30-16:00. Front desk will prepare a printed schedule and a "family-friendly" welcome card.

care-team: We can offer a quiet waiting area for children if candidate needs to bring a caregiver briefly; however, company policy does not supervise childcare. We can provide a small activity pack (non-food) and a low-sensory corner. Recommend candidate arrange a caregiver or daycare and submit receipt for stipend.

rachel (recruiter): Lena prefers to use a vetted daycare for the interview day and asked how to get the stipend reimbursed. Can you confirm submission details and whether we can send the stipend upfront as a voucher?

lena (people-ops): Two options: 1) Reimburse after candidate submits receipt to expenses@redwood.com (project HIRING-REIMB) OR 2) issue a short-term childcare voucher through our vendor (KidCareNow) if timing is tight. KidCareNow booking requires candidate name and ZIP and charges a small booking fee we cover. Which do you prefer?

rachel (recruiter): Candidate would prefer the voucher option to avoid paying upfront. Travel-team, can you coordinate with KidCareNow and include it on the candidate logistics email?

travel-team: We can coordinate KidCareNow booking. Need the candidate's ZIP code and preferred window (11:30-15:30). We'll absorb the booking fee. Please confirm and we'll send voucher + hotel hold details to Lena.

rachel (recruiter): Lena's ZIP for booking: 94110. Preferred childcare window: 11:30-15:30. I'll DM you her phone.

it-support-bot: Quick tech check: does Lena want a loaner laptop or will she bring her own? We can image a loaner Windows machine and reserve a quiet desk with a monitor. ETA loaner imaging: 24h.

rachel (recruiter): She prefers to bring her laptop but asked for a charger and a secondary monitor. Can we reserve a monitor + dock?

it-support-bot: Monitor + USB-C dock reserved at the desk. Charger on standby at reception.

front-desk: We'll print the KidCareNow voucher & hotel confirmation to hand to candidate if she prefers physical copies. We'll also hold a family-parking pass F1 and the monitor pack. Reception note: "Candidate traveling with childcare plans; please provide printed voucher and avoid overhead announcements."

sam (hiring mgr): Two operational asks: 1) Add a calendar note: "Candidate needs to pick up child by 15:30  please keep debriefs to 15m." 2) Zoom fallback + disable recording.

lena (people-ops): Done : I updated the invite with the KidCareNow voucher option, hotel hold link, expense instructions for receipts, and the calendar note about early pick-up. Also attached a one-paragraph privacy blurb about childcare vendor data handling.

rachel (recruiter): Candidate confirmed shell accept the KidCareNow voucher and hotel hold. She asked whether we can also provide a small refrigerator access (to store expressed milk or meds) for the day. Is that possible?

care-team: Yes, we can provide access to a staff fridge in the wellness room. We'll reserve a small locked compartment and mark it with candidate initials; reception will escort items to fridge. Please note fridge access is for short-term interview-day storage only.

travel-team: Hotel hold & dinner voucher sent to candidate email. KidCareNow voucher initiated; booking confirmation pending candidate phone verification. Rideshare code included for airport transfer.

front-desk: Fridge compartment reserved in Wellness Room W2; key code will be provided to candidate at check-in. We'll include pick-up instructions and tag the schedule.

rachel (recruiter): Invites sent: 2026-05-20 10:30-11:00 remote screen (Zoom), 12:00-15:00 onsite (Conf J). KidCareNow voucher and hotel confirmation included. Added note about fridge + monitor + no recording. Candidate acknowledged and said "thank you so much". :pray:

candidate-bot: Lena confirmed hotel + childcare booking received and appreciated the fridge accommodation. She also asked to keep any whiteboard discussions on a single sheet photo to avoid having to copy things down during pick-up.

sam (hiring mgr): Good idea  we'll take photos and share them in the debrief doc. Thanks everyone for the quick support.

lena (people-ops): Final checklist in invite: Hotel hold (Marriott Downtown), Dinner voucher $40, KidCareNow voucher (11:30-15:30), Family parking F1, Conf J reserved, Monitor + charger at reception, Wellness Room fridge compartment W2 reserved, expense/reimbursement instructions attached. Closing thread  reopen if bookings change."
